questions.q: An Arizona rider who is age 18 or older
options: Must wear one on every trip
questions.explanation: The Arizona age rule is aimed at riders 17 and younger. Some states add a novice or insurance condition, so read the statute before riding without a helmet.

Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
